searchText: can someone explain how the eth1 in eth2 demo works? didn't they have to reprogram geth ? Geth has a notion of "consensus engines". The current two are PoW and clique. This demo creates a third that is controlled via RPC (insert block, update head, etc) and the eth2 client (the driver of the consensus) controls geth via this RPC Huh didn’t know that! Thanks for explaining that <@291925846556540928>
